_note: Source of truth for the reviews wall. Add entries here, then run: python tools/build-reviews.py

_fields.quote: required - review text, no surrounding quote marks (the card draws those)
_fields.name: required - reviewer or store name
_fields.role: optional - role, company. Shown under the name when present
_fields.date: optional - review date. Used as the sub-line when there is no role
_fields.logo: optional - path under assets/ for the brand mark
_fields.logoAlt: optional - accessible name for the logo
_fields.avatar: optional - path under assets/ for a photo; omit to fall back to initials
_fields.initials: optional - overrides the initials derived from the name
